title: Argus: Academic Integrity in the Era of Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.36073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in the context of education has introduced significant challenges in enforcement of academic integrity, especially in programming courses. We present Argus, an automated detection system for LLM-assisted student work in undergraduate C programming assignments. Argus integrates behavioral and stylistic indicators to create a holistic picture of the student's progress through an assignment and surfaces anomalies that point to potential misuse of LLM assistance. We quantify and analyze data over six years of Spring semester offerings in a large-enrollment CS2 course at Purdue University using Argus, finding that 45% of enrolled students exhibited patterns consistent with LLM-assisted code development in Spring 2026. translated_title: Argus：生成式AI时代的学术诚信
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在教育领域的快速普及给学术诚信的执行带来了重大挑战，尤其是在编程课程中。我们提出了Argus，一个用于检测本科C语言编程作业中LLM辅助学生作业的自动化检测系统。Argus整合了行为和风格方面的指标，以全面呈现学生在完成作业过程中的整体进展，并从中发现指向潜在LLM辅助滥用的异常现象。我们使用Argus对普渡大学一门大班额CS2课程六年春季学期的数据进行了量化与分析，发现2026年春季有45%的选课学生表现出与LLM辅助代码开发相一致的模式。为了给这些结果提供背景，我们分析了被标记的LLM使用情况与学生在现场监考的书面考试中的表现之间的关系，并发现了显著的……
tldr: 普渡大学开发的Argus系统能够自动检测学生在C语言编程作业中使用LLM辅助的行为，六年数据显示2026年春季高达45%的学生表现出LLM辅助编程模式，且这种使用与监考考试成绩显著相关。
en_tdlr: Argus is an automated system that detects LLM-assisted work in undergraduate C programming assignments, and six years of Purdue University data reveal that 45% of students in Spring 2026 exhibited patterns consistent with LLM-assisted code development, significantly correlating with proctored exam performance.
